dict.string: Sleepy Notch moves the mic's bars with your voice while another app is using the microphone. Nothing is recorded or saved.
Sleepy Notch shows how far your downloads have got, beside the notch.
Sleepy Notch reminds you a few minutes before meetings start, with a button to join the call.
